sources.title: GitHub - nexustar/quickasr: C inference for Qwen3-ASR 0.6b and 1.7b ...
sources.snippet: It currently runs the Qwen3-ASR models (0.6B and 1.7B). The core is plain C with no dependencies beyond the C standard library and a BLAS implementation (Accelerate on macOS, OpenBLAS on Linux and Windows); make gpu adds an optional GPU path (Metal, Vulkan) through ggml. quickasr started as a fork of antirez/qwen-asr.
